text:
Aisha: quick run notes — enabled OOM-hedging reserve (soft 150MB per-invocation) + dynamic kernel chooser that prefers FlashAttn for seq<=1024, Triton for >1024. Baseline: 6k tokens/s, p95 220ms. With hedging: tokens/s 5.4k, p95 240ms, OOMs dropped from 7->1 in 1hr. weird spike at 09:17 where lat went to 800ms.

Dmitri: can you paste the exact config? also which cuBLASLt path was triggered on the spike?

Aisha: snippet: ```json
{"reserve_mb":150, "kernel_policy": [{"max_seq":1024, "kernel":"flash"},{"min_seq":1025,"kernel":"triton"}], "kv_eviction":"lru_soft"}
```

Rene: the 800ms likely cuBLASLt fallback + slab reclamation pause. Did we see GC-like free/alloc churn?

Maria: telemetry? timeline pls.

Aisha: attached profile (summarized) — 09:16:55 to 09:17:05: spike corresponds to a 3x increase in slab reclaim calls; cuBLASLt path reported 1 failed algorithm -> fallback to cublasLtGemmEx; allocator logged blocking_wait=120ms.

Jon: iirc we added blocking_wait metric last week. If allocator does blocking on reclaim, soft reserve won't help because it forces other requests to wait. maybe change reclaim to async background? :thinking:

Dmitri: alternative: prefer triton 1st for mid sequences to avoid flash->fallback oscillation. Flash has faster steady-state but brittle on mem fragmentation.

Aisha: perf/regression detail: small batch single-request 1 core: flash wins. For mixed batch (1-8) with KV heavy, triton variant had more predictable p95.

Rene: proposal: two-tier kernel policy + adaptive probing: keep flash for short and light-KV, but if reclaim rate > threshold, switch model-instance to 'hedge-triton' for 30s.

Maria: can we expose soft-reserve reclaimable flag per-request so we can steal reserve from low-priority requests? we'd need accounting in allocator.

Jon: implement quick probe: add 'probe_budget' to allocator metadata; before choosing flash, query probe_budget>0 else choose triton. cheap to test.

Aisha: will run AB with probe_budget=2 and reclaim async; pushing PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2928|runtime#2928>

alloc-bot: test CI passed for PR 2928 :white_check_mark:

Dmitri: sounds good. Also monitor KV cache hit-rate — if hit-rate drops, we may be evicting too aggressively. set eviction headroom to +50MB for KV.

Aisha: running AB now, will post results in ~1hr. thanks all :party-parrot: 

Maria: add a trace to show which kernel chosen per-request in tracing spans (use tag kernel.name) — helps debug if oscillation is due to per-token switches.

Jon: and add metric 'slab_fragmentation_pct' to dashboard.

Rene: file a follow-up for longer run and OOM marker correlation.
